City Council Meeting
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA City Council Meeting
September 26, 2017 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
65TH ANNIVERSARY RECOGNITION – JACK AND NANCY JENKINS - It is recommended the City Council present Jack and Nancy Jenkins with a 65th Wedding Anniversary certificate and two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts.
6.1 65th Wedding Anniversary Recognition
6.2
RECOGNITION OF LA MIRADA ARMADA SWIM TEAM - It is recommended the City Council recognize the championship members and coaches of the La Mirada Armada and present them with Certificates of Recognition.
6.2 Recognition of La Mirada Armada
6.3
RECOGNITION OF EMPLOYEE FOR YEARS OF SERVICE - It is recommended the City Council recognize Alison Moore for her years of service and present her with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.
6.3 Recognition of Employee for Years of Service
7.

7.1
APPOINTMENT TO THE PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION - It is recommended the City Council appoint Desiree Johnson to the Public Safety Commission for a term ending in June 2019.
7.1 Appointment to Public Safety Commission
8.

8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of September 12, 2017 and the minutes of the regular meeting of September 12, 2017.
8.1 SS 9-12-17 Minutes
8.1 CC 9-12-17 Minutes
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated September 26, 2017 in the total amount of $947,068.63.
8.2 Warrant Register

MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING AUGUST 2017 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending August 31, 2017.

CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2016-06, FURNITURE, FIXTURES & EQUIPMENT (FF&E) FOR THE LA MIRADA LIBRARY RENOVATION PROJECT - It is recommended the City Council accept the furniture, fixtures and equipment provided and installed by Yamada Enterprises; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the contract.

8.7
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE TWO UTILITY VEHICLES - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of two utility vehicles and authorize the surplus of two existing utility vehicles.
8.7 Authorization to Purchase Vehicles
9.
PUBLIC HEARING
9.1
INTERIM ORDINANCE NO. 699-U EXTENDING INTERIM ORDINANCE NO. 697-U, PROHIBITING NEW ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS (ALSO REFERRED TO AS "SECOND DWELLING UNITS") EXCEPT THOSE THAT SATISFY SPECIFIED STANDARDS, AND DECLARING THE URGENCY THEREOF - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law and adopt Ordinance No. 699-U extending interim Ordinance No. 697-U, prohibiting new accessory dwelling units (also referred to as "second dwelling units") except those that satisfy specified standards, and declaring the urgency thereof.
9.1 Ordinance NO. 699-U
10.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
10.1
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 698 ESTABLISHING REGULATIONS FOR MAINTAINING AND REGISTERING VACANT OR ABANDONED COMMERCIAL PROPERTIES AND STOREFRONTS AND AMENDING TITLE 9 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE - It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 698 establishing regulations for maintaining and registering vacant or abandoned commercial properties and storefronts and amending Title 9 of the La Mirada Municipal Code, by title only, and waive further reading.
10.1 Ordinance No. 698
10.2
RESOLUTION NO. 17-29 APPROVING THE COMMITMENT OF A FUND BALANCE FOR ECONOMIC UNCERTAINTY FOR THE GENERAL FUND - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-29 approving the commitment of a Fund Balance for economic uncertainty for the General Fund.
10.2 Resolution No. 17-29
10.3
RESOLUTION NO. 17-30 ESTABLISHING A REGISTRATION FEE FOR VACANT OR ABANDONED COMMERCIAL PROPERTIES OR STOREFRONTS - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-30 establishing a registration fee for vacant or abandoned commercial properties or storefronts.
10.3 Resolution No. 17-30
